answers.question: If I report here, who finds out?
answers.answer: When the Sexual Violence Prevention and Response Office makes a report, the names of the individuals who made the disclosure are not included unless deemed necessary or with express consent. If an investigation takes place, the relevant office ensures appropriate support services are made available to the individual who made the disclosure.

citations.quote: The name or names of the individual or individuals who made the Disclosure or Disclosures will not be included in the Report unless the Director of the relevant Sexual Violence Prevention and Response Office believes it is necessary to do so (because of the risk of significant harm to the community or anyone’s health or safety) or has received express consent from the individual or individuals for their name or names to be included.

If the Director of Investigations decides to investigate a Report made to them under section 10.1 or 10.2 of this Policy, the Director of the relevant Sexual Violence Prevention and Response Office will notify the individual or individuals who made the Disclosure or Disclosures that an Investigation is taking place and ensure that appropriate support services are made available to the individual or individuals.

answers.question: If I report here, who finds out?
answers.answer: When a survivor makes a report to the university, the Sexual Violence Support and Prevention Office will inform the office responsible for the Complainant that a report has been received. If the report is about an employee, the responsible office will also determine the respondent's supervisor and inform them that a report has been received.

answers.question: If I report here, who finds out?
answers.answer: When a disclosure is made to certain offices, a record is created and forwarded to EQHR for confidential retention. Additionally, a university employee who receives a disclosure may need to share it with others to properly perform their employment duties.

citations.quote: Campus Security, the Office of Student Life, Residence Services, Faculty Relations and Human Resources will create a record of any Disclosure they receive and forward it to EQHR for confidential retention.
A University employee who receives a Disclosure may need to share it with others to properly perform their employment duties.
